guide_subtitle: Application usage, inner mechanics, and developer roadmap
guide_user_stockcards_desc: Stock cards are the fundamental entities of the application. In the 'Stock Cards' tab, you can define new items, specify minimum stock limits, and set units of measurement (e.g. pieces, meters). Establish parent-child card relationships to divide your inventory into subsets.
guide_user_movements_desc: To update stock quantities, you record Entry or Exit movements. In the 'Stock Movements' tab, select the operation type, department, and receiver staff to log movements. You can also bulk import stock movements from an Excel sheet using the 'Import from Excel' button.
guide_user_services_desc: Track malfunctioning or service-routed equipment in the 'Services' tab. Enter service statuses (Pending, Resolved, etc.), department, and maintenance logs to monitor the complete lifecycle of equipment.
guide_user_backup_desc: To secure your inventory data, you can create a direct SQLite file copy (.db) or export SQL scripts (.sql) in the 'Settings' tab. Stokendra automatically checks and performs daily backups on its first launch every day.
guide_user_reports_desc: Review real-time inventory status, statistics, and graphs on the Dashboard. Use the 'Export to Excel' button at the top of data tables to generate spreadsheets, or press the printer icon to print directly to PDF.
guide_dev_mvvm_desc: Stokendra utilizes a clean, loosely-coupled MVVM pattern. The user interface (View) is completely separated from the business logic (ViewModel). All services and ViewModels are registered in Program.cs using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection as singleton or transient components.
guide_dev_folders_desc:
• Views: XAML UI layout specifications (.axaml, .axaml.cs).
• ViewModels: Data binding classes leveraging CommunityToolkit.Mvvm (ObservableProperty, RelayCommand).
• Data: SQLite connection factories, repositories (StockCardRepository, etc.), and migrations.
• Infrastructure: LocalizationManager, LExtension, and other shared components.
• Resources: Localization JSON documents.
guide_dev_lang_desc: The application relies on JSON-based localization resources (lang_tr.json, lang_en.json). Text fields in XAML are bound via the custom '{infra:L key}' markup extension. When language preferences change, LocalizationManager automatically reloads resources and refreshes views on the fly.
guide_dev_db_desc: Database queries are written in raw SQL and optimized with correlated subqueries for high performance. When the database structure changes, 'Database.Migrations.cs' performs incremental schema upgrades (e.g. V12) without deleting user data.
guide_dev_roadmap_desc:
1. Multi-user session management (Role-based access controls for Admin/Staff).
2. Cloud database synchronization (Real-time synchronization with Firebase or PostgreSQL).
3. Automated stock alert notifications via Email/SMS when limits are crossed.
